lesson.title: Procedure 414 – FIRE INCIDENTS
objectives: Apply dispatcher responsibilities for fire incidents, including FD/EMS messaging and documentation.
Apply structural fire safety transmission and color-coded fire job response rules.
Apply load sharing deferral rules and exceptions, including transit/zone responsibilities.
Apply supervisor and duty captain assignment rules when FD and police are present.
Apply explosion handling, FD emergency notifications, and FD link-down procedures.
